unit: Phase 6 core services and SDK v7 board
notes: Records the twelve-unit Phase 6 board and dependency plan in docs/port/p6-launch-brief.md. Plan order: p6-001 library service; p6-002 import service; p6-003 Steam sync; p6-004 settings service; p6-005 metadata service; p6-006 notifications, dialogs and main-view API; p6-007 URI handler and HTML description service; p6-008 SDK Abstractions freeze and ApiCompat report; p6-009 sample plugins; p6-010 add-on manifest and installation model (store is v1.1); p6-011 CLI query surface; p6-012 repository-level ordered paging for list/search (required before Phase 7 UI). Dependencies: p6-001 first; p6-002, p6-004 and p6-005 on p6-001; p6-003 on p6-002 and p5-002; p6-006 on p6-001 and p5-007a; p6-007 on p5-005a and p6-005; p6-008 after p6-001..p6-007; p6-009 after p6-008; p6-010 after p6-009 and p3-005; p6-011 on p6-001; p6-012 on p6-001 and p6-011. Exit gate recorded in the brief: CLI import/list/search/launch dry-run without UI; Abstractions build plus reviewed ApiCompat report plus sample plugins compiling and loading; no Core reference to Avalonia directly or transitively; fake-host contract tests for every SDK interface. This PR owns only the p6-shards namespace, so it appends the board instead of creating or rewriting the p6-001..p6-012 rows; each unit PR carries its own row and fragment because the guards allow one unit namespace per PR. The 2026-11-20 correction narrows p6-001 to the library service only, as delivered by https://github.com/seanburkes/playnite-linux/pull/161, and adds p6-011 CLI query surface and p6-012 repository-level ordered paging; ownership.paths is not edited because it is bot-owned, its guard reads the base map, and firstmate confirms attribution after the new units' commits merge. The seeded p6-001..p6-005 rows predate the plan and are redefined by their own PRs. The 2026-11-20 second revision finalises the four remaining unstarted rows p6-007 URI handler and HTML description service, p6-008 SDK Abstractions freeze and ApiCompat report, p6-009 sample plugins and p6-010 add-on manifest and installation model in docs/port/p6-launch-brief.md: exact dependencies and their current state, owner, oracle and test labels, and the foreign-owned or protected paths each unit must avoid editing (p6-008 must instead route its protected Abstractions declarations through the oracle-change label). The revision also records the Phase 6 exit gate and its evidence state, which remains unaccepted. It creates no other unit's queue shard or fragment because the guards allow one unit namespace per pull request, and it does not rewrite a delivered unit's row; p6-003 is disclosed as merged at 3ee1379 with an open queue row. No product code, test, protected oracle, baseline or generated aggregate is changed. Phase 6 exit-gate evidence assessment delivered in docs/port/gates/P6-pending.md (EVIDENCE ONLY; not acceptance): 3 PROVEN / 1 PARTIAL / 0 DEFERRED. Criterion 1 PARTIAL: import/list/search succeed on the committed v10 fixture and launch --dry-run returns the documented NoPlayAction exit 5 because fixture games use library-plugin actions, so a started:false plan needs a committed fixture with a stored play action; no-UI condition proven by CLI project graph and deps closure. Criterion 2 PROVEN: Abstractions build with ApiCompat (exit 0), committed 306-diff v6-to-v7 report (208/82/15/1 -> 114 adapted/178 deferred/14 excluded/0 breaking), Playnite.Plugin.Tests 15/0/0, PublicAPI regeneration NO DIFF under RS0016/RS0017-as-errors. Criterion 3 PROVEN: Architecture tests 210/0/0 plus direct graph tests 4/0/0, Core -> SDK.Abstractions only, no Avalonia in closure. Criterion 4 PROVEN: 13 interfaces (3 seed + 6 p6-006 + 4 p6-007) all covered, reflection test 1/0/0, Core contract classes 26/0/0. Gate not claimed; acceptance is the captain's decision after review; P6-accepted.md intentionally not written. Reassessed on current main after #220 (6a2672a) at 7167cbc: all four exit criteria RE-RUN, not copied, and every command succeeded, giving 4 PROVEN / 0 PARTIAL / 0 DEFERRED. Criterion 1 closed: the earlier PARTIAL (committed fixture only produced library-plugin-action games, so no real-process started:false plan) was resolved by the process-level launch --dry-run proof added in #220 -- dotnet test tests/Playnite.Core.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~LaunchProcessDryRunTests re-run here -> 1 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped, exit 0, with a real child CLI process printing kind=launch, dryRun=true, started=false, actionType=File and no sentinel executed; the committed-fixture import/list/search success (exit 0) and launch --dry-run NoPlayAction refusal (exit 5) are retained, and the no-UI condition is proven by CLI project graph, deps.json and output directory. Criteria 2/3/4 re-verified at 7167cbc: Abstractions ApiCompat build exit 0, 306-diff v6-to-v7 report (114 adapted/178 deferred/14 excluded/0 breaking), Playnite.Plugin.Tests 15/0/0, PublicAPI regeneration NO DIFF with --verify-no-changes exit 0; Architecture tests 210/0/0 and direct no-Avalonia graph tests 4/0/0 with Core -> SDK.Abstractions only and no Avalonia in closure; 13 SDK interfaces all covered with reflection test 1/0/0 and Core contract classes 26/0/0. This is still EVIDENCE ONLY; acceptance remains the captain's decision; P6-accepted.md intentionally not written.
